name: Giant Chocolate Chip Cookies (Metric)
desc: The same giant cookies by weight, with the flour bumped for Salt Lake altitude.

source.title: Giant Chocolate Chip Cookies
source.evidence: Tessa Arias's recipe: same cold cubed butter, 380 g flour base, 150 g granulated and 250 g light brown sugar, chips plus reserved chunks, 113 g balls at 375°F; this version adds 16 g flour for Salt Lake altitude.

ingredients.raw: 396 g all-purpose flour (380 g plus 16 g for altitude)
227 g (2 sticks) cold unsalted butter, cubed, straight from the fridge
170 g semisweet chocolate chunks, hand-chopped from a bar, divided

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Line two large baking sheets with parchment.
Tare a medium bowl on the scale and weigh in the flour. Add the fine sea salt, baking powder and baking soda and whisk well.

Tare the stand mixer bowl and weigh in the cold butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar. Beat on low, increasing to medium-high, until combined and fluffy, 3-4 minutes. Cold butter takes longer than soft; do not use softened butter.
Add the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla, beating until combined.
On low speed, add the dry mix gradually, mixing only until combined. Beat in the chocolate chips and half the chunks (85 g).
Portion 113 g dough balls on the scale (you should get 12). Roll them even, place 6 per pan spaced far apart, and press the remaining 85 g chunks into the tops.
Bake 15-20 minutes. For crispy edges, check at 17 and pull around 18 to 19 when the edge ring is golden brown and the center is puffy. Shorter is gooier, longer crispier.
Sprinkle with flaky salt right out of the oven. The cookies deflate slightly as they cool; let them set on the pan before moving.
tips: The 2 tbsp (16 g) flour above Tessa's 380 g is an altitude adjustment for Salt Lake City; at sea level use 3 cups (380 g).
Handle the Heat's own range is 15 to 20 minutes. Best the day they are baked; they keep 2 days airtight.

references.title: Giant Chocolate Chip Cookies
references.usedFor: confirmed amounts (1 1/4 cups / 250 g brown sugar), 15 to 20 minute bake range, deflating cue, storage, yield
